title: SCOPE-MOVE: evidence explorer for method selection
description: SCOPE-MOVE is an interactive dashboard to explore research studies training or testing wrist-accelerometer-based prediction models for classifying sleep, sedentary behaviour, or physical activity. Version 2.0.0 replaces the earlier Shiny prototype with a web-based evidence explorer. The repository preserves the reproducible extraction inputs, analysis scripts, app data-building workflow, and documentation needed to regenerate manuscript-facing outputs associated with the scoping review study, which is currently at journal submission stage.
